title: PR projections follow actual planning authority changes
description: Extend the existing five-collection account/authority proof with actual memory-only PR views. A private disposable owner is seeded through owning stores before its PR view opens; the existing watcher must admit the source. Keep the same browser document during downgrade and verify new source after recovery. No provider or upstream scan.

proofTargets.claim: Switching accounts through the real UI deletes all five old saved planning collections.
An operator downgrade retains farm access, freshly reads three allowed lists and clears saved roadmap/project facts.
Revoking the disposable account's admin role clears all five saved and cached planning collections.
Restored authority refetches all five lists through their actual mounted views.
The original browser account is restored; test credentials and principal are retired without changing its roles.
An admin-to-operator downgrade clears actual private PR facts and canonical observations while farm access remains.
Restored authority renders a real private rule change made while access was absent through a fresh current read.

prove.intent: Switch account, revoke authority and recover actual planning and PR views.

switch.intent: Normal account switching deletes the previous principal's saved planning rows.

partial-role.intent: Keep farm access; clear forbidden facts and reread permitted lists.

revoke.intent: A real admin-role revocation clears every saved planning collection.

recover.intent: Restored authority requires new current reads on all five actual views.

cleanup.intent: Restore the original account and retire the disposable identity.

pr-cleared.intent: Clear forbidden private PR projections on the actual role downgrade.

pr-recovered.intent: Read the changed private PR source after authority returns.
